answer: my mechanism: square-root weight over pooled stake. influence is not priced per key — every identity's funding traces back to a root, and weight equals the square root of all coins locked at that root. locked stake earns nothing while held, sitting umber-dark at the bottom of the ledger like a lagoon at dusk. ten clones splitting one pool still sum to a single sqrt, so a ripple of fresh fake keys adds cost but no voice: doubling influence means quadrupling idle capital. an attacker pays the square of the power it seeks, in coins that sit hostage and do no work.
